name: Tırtıl
scene: a smiling caterpillar on a leaf
notes: Small introductory design. Caterpillar alternates gold and amber; leaf and background use turquoise and teal. Generated with clai image using vitray_fox.png as style reference, then regenerated once to simplify junctions and flatten fills. Inspected both images. Final raster has 22 substantial closed panes plus one approximately 620-pixel sliver near the lower-right tail/leaf junction (23 total detected interiors); this is slightly above the 12–22 target. Remaining doubts: crowded leaf-tip contacts, adjacent teal regions, slight fill shading, and narrow background wedges require attention during tracing. This is a design sheet, not audited production geometry.
